newsitem.title: UK: Barclays seen lower after 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Barclays seen lower after 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc were seen opening lower on Tuesday after the banking group posted full-year profits at the low end of analyst expectations, dealers said.
"The results were a little disappointing," said one senior trader, "they will open about 20p lower but then they will rally."

Barclays' pre-tax profit rose 13 percent to 2.36 billion stg, including an exceptional gain on disposals -- compared with an exceptional gain of 238 million stg a year before -- with operating profit at its investment banking unit BZW down 29 percent to 204 million stg.
Analyst forecasts for group pre-tax profits had mostly been in a range between 2.33 billion stg and 2.45 billion
Yet Barclays raised its dividend 21 percent to 31.5p and said it would return 500 million stg to shareholders in the next twelve months.
